The '''first season''' of the animated ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series premiered on [[October 3]], 2008, with the airing of the episodes "[[Ambush]]" and "[[Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence'']]" on [[Cartoon Network]]. Four episodes were originally intended to be part of the first season, but they were instead combined and released as a feature animated film, [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']], on August 15, 2008.

====''Decoded''====
{{Main|Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decoded}}
A number of Season One episodes were re-screened as ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decoded'', including pop-up boxes containing trivia and behind-the-scenes information relating to each episode.<ref name="SWArchive-The Clone Wars: Decoded on May 1 on Cartoon Network">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20090406.html|text=''The Clone Wars: Decoded'' on May 1 on Cartoon Network}}</ref>
